svg.aria-label: Sketch after photographs of the Federal Reserve's press-conference backdrop on Sept. 16: a draped U.S. flag on a pole at left, the Board of Governors' banner at right with its circular seal, ring of stars and an eagle, gold fringe along both flags' edges, a dark curtain behind, and two gooseneck microphones rising from the lectern in the foreground. The chair who spoke is not drawn.
